name: Delaware
checked: 2026-10-09; 2026-10-10 by N10 (the reader's own requests through election/source.py)
status_why: The Department's JSON files answered scripts; the kit already reads them.
system: State-built: the Department of Elections' results pages with JSON files beside them (elections.delaware.gov/results/enr/).

election.how_to_find: Expected GE2026 (PR2026 for the primary); the reader asks for the statewide file and finds nothing until it is posted.

feeds.address: https://elections.delaware.gov/results/enr/<code>.html with https://elections.delaware.gov/results/enr/Election_StatewideResults_ID_<code>.json and Election_ByCountyWithWilmington_ID_<code>.json; code PR2026 for the Sept 15 primary, GE2026 expected for Nov 3 (GE2024 for 2024, by the same naming; not requested)
feeds.updates: Election night as districts report; frequency not stated.
feeds.note: results/index.html answered 200 on 2026-10-09 and links 'Tuesday, Septermber 15, 2026: Primary Election Official Results' to results/enr/PR2026.html; an archive page lists earlier generals (elections/election_archive.html).

races_in_feed: Federal, statewide (treasurer, auditor, attorney general in 2026), legislature, county council and county row offices; school board elections are in May and municipal ones are run by the towns.
local: No: county contests are on the Department's pages; New Castle County, Kent and Sussex do not run results sites. School results at elections.delaware.gov/school/results.html.
how_counted: Delaware reports machine, early and absentee votes separately.
count_order: Machine, absentee and early-voting votes per candidate.
vote_types: Yes: the JSON carries machine, absentee and early-voting votes for each candidate (de.py).

certify.body: the Governor, on the counties' returns
certify.rule: The Governor examines the returns and declares the persons elected without delay after receiving each county's results (Del. Code tit. 15, 5710-5713).
certify.local_rule: County canvass at 10 a.m. on the second day after the election (Del. Code tit. 15, 5701).
certify.source: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself

rehearsal: PR2026 (the Sept 15 primary, official), kept in election_cache/replay/sources/<code>-<id>/ (kept 2026-10-10 by N10 for rehearsals). The 2024 general's files are not under GE2024 (404 on 2026-10-10).
scout_plan: Live-readable. Confirm the GE2026 file names from the results index on Nov 3 afternoon, then read the two JSON files every 3 to 5 minutes; they already split machine, early and absentee votes, which feeds the count-order predictor directly.
notes: Reader (N10, 2026-10-10): de_json. check() asks for the statewide file (conditional); fetch() it and the county file. Machine, absentee and early votes are kept apart and must add to the total.
to_do: GE2026 is the expected code (the primary's was PR2026); until it is posted the reader's check finds nothing and asks again. Confirm it from the results index on Nov 3.
sources: NCSL, 'Election Certification Deadlines' (www.ncsl.org/elections-and-campaigns/certification-deadlines), read 2026-10-10; secondary: a summary of each state's law, not the law itself
